name: All-Clad D5 Stainless Steel 4-Quart Soup Pot
description: All-Clad D5® Stainless Steel 4 Qt Soup Pot with Lid, Made in the USA
features: Made for comfort cooking and generous bowls. This D5 4-quart Soup Pot is perfect for simmering broths, hearty soups, stews, and chowders. The deep shape helps retain heat and flavor, while the lid locks in moisture for rich results every time.

Built for professional kitchens & cherished by home cooks this heirloom cookware is Made in the USA with global components in our Pennsylvania Factory since 1971. As the inventor of bonded metal cookware, All-Clad continues to define trusted performance.

Upgrade to D5 Stainless, built on the original 5-ply bonded technology invented by All-Clad. The steel core provides supremely even, steady heat for perfect braising and pan roasting, while the stainless steel surface creates a flawless sear.

Elevated in both form and function, D5 Stainless features a refined brushed stainless steel finish, flared edges for drip-free pouring, and generously sized, double-riveted stainless steel handles for a secure, confident grip.

Built to outlast, each piece is precision engineered and third-party tested for safety—delivering performance you can trust. Backed by five decades of manufacturing expertise, All-Clad sets the standard for professional kitchen performance.
Backed by our Limited Warranty. Our cookware is oven & broiler safe up to 600°F and compatible with any stovetop, including induction. Handwash Only.
